blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Friday reminded police officers to uphold the “highest standards of discipline” as it will not tolerate abuse of authority. NCRPO Officer-in-Charge Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano made the statement amid intensified security measures for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. A full alert status was declared on Friday and will remain in effect until Nov. 19. According to the Philippine National Police (PNP), the alert status will be extended when deemed necessary. “Every police officer represents the institution wherever he or she is assigned.
